text: 領域別QUADPACKと有限Simpson対照 QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions 領域別QUADPACKと有限Simpson対照 \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-x^2}\,dx=\sqrt\pi;\quad\int_0^1e^{-x}\sin(\omega x)\,dx=\frac{\omega-e^{-1}(\sin\omega+\omega\cos\omega)}{1+\omega^2};\quad\int_0^\infty e^{-x}\sin(8x)\,dx=\frac8{65};\quad\int_0^1|x-3/8|^{-1/2}\,dx=2(\sqrt{3/8}+\sqrt{5/8}) 無限Gaussian、有限振動2周波数、半無限Fourier、内部特異点。絶対公差1e-6/1e-8/1e-10、epsrel=0。 QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-x^2}\,dx=\sqrt\pi;\quad\int_0^1e^{-x}\sin(\omega x)\,dx=\frac{\omega-e^{-1}(\sin\omega+\omega\cos\omega)}{1+\omega^2};\quad\int_0^\infty e^{-x}\sin(8x)\,dx=\frac8{65};\quad\int_0^1|x-3/8|^{-1/2}\,dx=2(\sqrt{3/8}+\sqrt{5/8}) Whole-line Gaussian, two finite frequencies, half-line Fourier and an internal singularity; absolute tolerances1e-6/1e-8/1e-10 and epsrel0. quadpack-domain-selection 領域別QUADPACKと有限Simpson対照 QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 解析解 Analytic reference
